name: together without a middleman
headline: Together, without a *middleman*
say: Working together happens directly between people. Open a swarm, and everyone in the room sees each other's tiles live. Take what you want, and it lands in your own hive. When someone leaves, their tiles leave with them. When work should stay, you publish it to a host. Either way, it moves from hive to hive by its signature and is checked when it arrives. No feed decides what you see.
